entries.reason: The activity dots are fixed 4x4 px circles; radius 2 is half the dot, a shape rather than a theme corner size.
The activity dots are fixed 4x4 px circles; radius 2 is half the dot, a shape rather than a theme corner size.
The StatusIndicator ring thickness is a sixth of the indicator diameter with a 2 px floor, so it scales with the ring.
The StatusIndicator cutout is a 1 px gap painted in the surface color by .facet-cutout; it separates the dot from content and is not the hairline role.
The progress trail is a translucent echo of the .facet-fill accent; the palette has no trail opacity, and 0.6 is relative to the themed fill color.
Only an authored backgroundTransparency reaches this black plate; the catcher stays untagged so .facet-scrim cannot override the caller's value, and unauthored scrims use the theme rule.

entries.match: return if contained then Host.UICorner({ CornerRadius = ctx.round }) else ctx.corner(3)
entries.reason: The slider rail and fill are thin bars; radius 3 rounds their ends into a capsule, a shape rather than a theme corner size. A contained rail is as thick as the knob and rounds fully into a pill. Both go square when the theme's radii.pill is 0 (ctx.round).
The radio indicator is a fixed 18 px circle; radius 9 is half its size.
The radio dot is a fixed 8 px circle; radius 4 is half its size.
The 18 px selection mark is square for multiple selection and a circle for single selection. ctx.corner removes rounding when the theme uses square corners.
The edit-mode selection mark's dot is the 8 px radio dot; radius 4 is half its size.
The push and pop shade dims the page beneath; black is the neutral dimming colour, the same rule as the modal scrim in nav_modal.luau, and a theme backdrop replaces it when one is set.
Colour value conversion: this builds the colour the player chose, not a paint colour of the control.
The swatch well outline separates any sample colour from the page; it has no theme metric.
The swatch well outline separates any sample colour from the page; it has no theme metric.
The plane position ring is white so it reads on every sample colour under it; it is part of the chosen colour display, not theme paint.
The today ring on a calendar day disc has no theme metric; its colour comes from the theme rule.
A pill or circle focus look: half the smaller side is a shape, not a theme corner size.
The focus halo colour is the theme recipe's own chrome.focus.halo RGB, converted to a Color3; it is theme data, not a hard-coded colour.
The default focus halo is pure black or pure white, whichever contrasts more with the theme's ring colour, so the ring reads over any scene; the extremes are the point, not a palette role.
The focus halo is half the themed ring thickness with a 1 px floor, so it scales with the ring and its ten-foot size.
